name: Journey to Sentinel Hill
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

Good luck out there, adventurer!
narrative.objectives: Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
narrative.offerRewardText: I've been begging Stormwind for aid for months and he sends me a skinny elf? Well, beggars can't be choosers I suppose.Welcome to Westfall, champion. Let's see if we can't put you to work.
